faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLE350d use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 2015 to 2019 (W166 generation), the GLE350d used the OM642 3.0-litre V6 diesel. From 2019 onwards (V167), it switched to the OM656 3.0-litre inline-six diesel — a completely different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLE350d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLE350d?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM642 or the OM656 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 GLE350d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM656 GLE350d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The OM656 is a newer engine, and we service it to the same standard as the OM642.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLE350d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLE350d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLE350d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLE350d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
